notes: Smart IP active install loudspeaker: single RJ45 carries AES67/Dante audio-over-IP input AND power simultaneously (no separate power inlet exists). Powered via PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at, 30W recommended) or PoE (802.3af, 15W, reduces sustained max output duration). Grade omitted on the RJ45 port because the spec describes it by PoE class and AES67/Dante audio streaming (32-96kHz, 16-24 bit), not by Ethernet link speed (100M/1G/etc.) — link speed is not stated on the manufacturer page. Available in black (4410AB) or white (4410AW) finishes; port configuration identical across variants. Desktop/surface-mount install speaker, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted).

ports.name: Network
ports.note: Single RJ45 accepts AES67/ST2110 and Dante audio-over-IP input (32-96kHz, 16-24 bit) and simultaneously delivers PoE/PoE+ power to the speaker; no separate power inlet.
